GET /api/captable/access/shared/:token.note: A capability link: no sign-in by design; the signed token must agree with its stored row on venture and level, and its expiry, view limit and revocation hold. Forged, unstored, other-venture, cross-kind, spent and revoked tokens are refused 403/410 and log no open; only the owner mints or revokes.

GET /api/captable/share/:token.note: A capability link: no sign-in by design; the signed token, its stored hash, expiry, view limit and revocation are the gate. Forged, unstored, cross-kind, spent and revoked tokens are refused 403/410, count no view and name nothing; another founder or an admin cannot revoke it.
